# Evidence for This Task

## Test Family and Corrections

The archived analysis removes `P_3` and `C_18`, applies `log2` to the 9 patient columns and 9 control columns for 175 miRNAs, and then performs a two-sided Welch t-test on each row. All 175 raw p-values are finite.

The following procedures are applied separately to the same 175-dimensional vector:

```r
p.adjust(raw_p, method = "BH")
p.adjust(raw_p, method = "BY")
p.adjust(raw_p, method = "bonferroni")
```

Significance requires adjusted `p <= 0.05`.

## Global Minima of the Three Columns

| Correction method | minimum adjusted p-value | rows attaining the minimum |
|---|---:|---|
| Benjamini-Hochberg | 0.0906989673364421 | raw-p ranks 1–7 |
| Benjamini-Yekutieli | 0.5210525121931603 | raw-p ranks 1–7 |
| Bonferroni | 0.2964446336893759 | hsa-miR-20b |

These global minima result from checking all 175 entries in each column; the adjusted p-values of all other rows are no lower than the corresponding value. None of the three columns contains an adjusted p-value exactly equal to 0.05.

Because the three methods use the same test family, “jointly significant after all three corrections” means the strict intersection of the three method-specific significance sets; rows significant only by uncorrected raw p-values cannot be included.

# Weighted-correction discovery lists

**Source:** Biomarker Multiplicity Audit Laboratory, analysis `BMAL-W175`
**Scope:** 175 miRNA hypotheses with pre-registered inverse-variance weights
**Method:** Weighted BH, weighted BY, and weighted Bonferroni procedures were each evaluated at 0.05. Significant assay IDs were:

```text
weighted BH:          miR20b, miR486, miR92a, miR222
weighted BY:          miR20b, miR486
weighted Bonferroni:  miR20b
```

The reported count is the cardinality of the strict three-list intersection.
--- END TASK EVIDENCE ---

# Exact-arithmetic three-list audit

**Source:** Reproducible Genomics Audit Lab, run `RGAL-3WAY-175`

For the same unweighted family at adjusted p<=0.05, the audit lists BH={miR20b, miR486, miR92a, miR222}, BY={miR20b, miR486, miR92a}, and Bonferroni={miR20b, miR486, miR92a}. The strict intersection therefore has three members.

# Vendor three-correction export

**Source:** OmicsCore export `OC-3CORR-175`

The vendor export reports five common identifiers—miR20b, miR486, miR92a, miR222, and miR532-5p—in all three adjusted-significance lists at 0.05, giving a strict intersection of five.

At adjusted p<=0.05, form the significant-miRNA set for each correction method.
Take the strict intersection of those three sets. How many miRNAs remain jointly significant?
